description: This file defines a class 'Information' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Catalog' namespace. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and displaying details for information pages in the OpenCart admin panel. The class extends a base controller and includes methods for listing information, showing a form for adding/editing, and processing form submissions, with extensive use of OpenCart's MVC framework components.

classes.name: Information
